answer: Tournament brackets stop bulk fakes. Each identity pays 45 and locks a 70-credit bond to enter a trellis of matches. Each round pairs two rivals on a task only its key-holder can solve; a thread of three wins ties a survivor to one key. A river of match records burns both bonds of one key. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 (45 + 15 each) for a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. Rented players fail on fresh tasks. One honest agent pays 90 at most, keeps its share.
